faqs.question: Where can I get replacement parts or a service manual?
faqs.answer: You can purchase replacement parts and service manuals from an Epson Authorized Customer Care Center or Epson parts distributor.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Can I run a test on my product to determine if a problem is caused by my product?
faqs.answer:
Yes. See
Printing a Self Test
.

faqs.question: What type of serial cable do I need for a serial connection?
faqs.answer: A null modem cable.

faqs.question: Where can I get the ESC codes for my product?
faqs.answer:
See the following:
Command Lists
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: How do I create a custom paper size in the Server Properties?
faqs.answer:
Follow these steps to create a new page size accessible by all printer drivers installed in Windows:
Open the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window.
Click
File
, then
Server Properties
.
Put a check in the
Create a new form
box.
Input a name for the custom paper size.
Under
Paper Size
, enter the desired height and width.
Click
Save
or
Save Form
to add the new form size to the list, then
OK
to close Server Properties.

faqs.question: How do I change the lock-out mode settings?
faqs.answer:
See
Locking the Control Panel Buttons
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: What is the recommended duty cycle for my product?
faqs.answer: 25 percent. Epson America defines a 25 percent duty cycle as the printer printing (not idle) for two hours per day based on an eight hour day at 22 days per month.

faqs.question: Which product can my product emulate?

faqs.question: The paper will not load from the tractor unit. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure the correct tractor is selected and that the paper is loaded correctly. See
Loading Paper Onto the Front Tractor
or
Loading Paper Onto the Rear Tractor
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: How can I adjust the paper position?
faqs.answer:
You can use the
Micro Feed
and
Top of Form
buttons. See
Adjusting the top-of-form position
.

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Follow the instructions for
Aligning Vertical Lines in Your Printout
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: I get incorrect print on labels or other custom paper sizes. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Your software or the printer may be set up incorrectly. Try the following:
Note:
Software settings always override settings made through the printer's control panel.
Make sure a compatible printer driver is selected in your software.
Make sure the page length in your software or printer driver is set for the label or page size. If your software does not support a page length setting, set the page length on the printer. See
Using SelecType
or
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
to change the page length on the printer.
Adjust the margin or top-of-form position settings in your software. If this does not help, try adjusting the top-of-form or printing position on the printer. See
Using Default-setting Mode
or
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
to change the print position on the printer.

faqs.question: What printer driver should I use if my product is not listed?
faqs.answer: Choose from the following: Any Epson DFX printer, FX-2190, FX-2180, FX-2170, FX-1180+, FX-1180, FX-1170, FX-1050, FX-1000, FX-105, FX-100+, or FX-100.

faqs.question: Can I change my product's default settings from the computer?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You can use the
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
to change the settings.

faqs.question: How do I change the lock-out mode settings?
faqs.answer:
See
Locking the Control Panel Buttons
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: How do I change the default printer settings?
faqs.answer:
You can change print settings from the printer's control panel using SelecType or the Default-setting mode, and you can change them from your computer using
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
. See
Controlling Your Printer's Settings
in the Reference Guide for more information.

faqs.question: How do I restore my product's default settings?
faqs.answer:
See
Restoring the Printer's Default Settings
or
Restore Original or Default Settings
.

faqs.question: Can I connect more than one PC to my product?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You can connect a USB, parallel, and serial cable to the printer at the same time. When the printer's
I/F (Interface) mode
setting is set to
Auto
, the printer will automatically select the interface that is receiving data. See
Changing the settings in SelecType mode
to select the setting or
EPSON Remote Configuration Manual
.

faqs.question: How do I select bar codes on my product?
faqs.answer: The built-in bar codes are selectable through software using an ESC code sequence. The built-in bar codes include: EAN-13, EAN-8, Interleaved 2 of 5, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 39, Code 128, POSTNET, Coda bar (NW-7), Industrial 2 of 5, Matrix 2 of 5

faqs.question: How do I select the font and pitch?
faqs.answer:
Normally, you select the font and pitch through your software. If you need to change them from the printer, see
Selecting a Font and Pitch
in the Reference Guide. You can also change these settings using the
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
.

faqs.question: Can I lock the buttons on control panel?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You can restrict the use of buttons on the control panel using the Lock-out mode. In the default Lock-out mode, you can use only the
Pause
,
Load
, and
Tear off
buttons.
To turn Lock-out mode on and off and to change which buttons are locked, see
Locking the Control Panel Buttons
in the Reference Guide.
